newsitem.title: ITALY: Rinascente losses increase in H1 1996.
newsitem.headline: Rinascente losses increase in H1 1996.

text.p: Italian retail chain Rinascente said it posted a first half 1996 parent company pre-tax loss of 38.0 billion lire against a 5.5 billion loss in the same 1995 period.

The company, part of the Fiat group, said in a statement that the result was not directly comparable due to the negative impact, put at 47.5 billion lire, of a change in distribution of resources within the group.
At group level, pre-tax losses were 500 million lire against a first half 1995 profit of 500 milion lire.
Group operating profit slipped to 5.1 billion from 6.0 billion, while gross sales rose 19.5 percent to 3.34 trillion lire from 2.80 trillion.
But sales rose only 4.6 percent if the effect of the July 1995 purchase of the Migliarini group and the spinoff of the Croff and Trony outlets was excluded.
For the whole of 1996, the company said it expected an improvement both at parent and group levels.
In 1995, Rinascente made a net consolidated profit of 85.8 billion lire against 101.9 billion in 1994.
